After an unusually long wait of three weeks, Apple has finally released iOS 27 beta 5 today, bringing a brand-new icon design for several apps including Siri and Safari.

Apple Redesigns App Icons in iOS 27 Beta 5

iOS 27 is getting closer to its official launch, expected to be released next month.

This beta 5 includes several user-visible changes, paving the way for the official version.

Several built-in apps have received new icons:

  • Siri
  • Safari
  • Preview
  • Settings
  • Remote

You can see some of the new icons in the image above, and other apps have received minor updates as well.

Since the first beta, iOS 27 has been gradually refining its icon design, with Apple continuing to polish the Liquid Glass aesthetic introduced last year.

Since iOS 27 beta testing began, apps such as Maps, Photos, and Wallet have gradually been given new icons. However, the changes in beta 5 show that Apple has not yet finished the icon adjustments for iOS 27.

What do you think of the latest app icon changes in iOS 27? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
